“Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited…

people.name: Nebuzaradan
people.line: Babylonian captain of the guard during Jerusalem's fall.

translations.web: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
translations.bsb: But Nebuzaradan left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people who had no property, and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.
translations.kjv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
translations.asv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, that had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
